verify.evidence: Program phase. 2026-11-14: the ADR-1287 increment is still in the tree, and the first creation-time coaching slice is in (lib/builder/vera-coach.test.ts, lib/ai/vera/block-coach.test.ts, app/(main)/pages/canvas/actions.test.ts, components/builder/inspector/vera-block-coach.test.tsx). Stays manual: the gate (one prompt to a valid, reviewable, single-undo page) has no page composer to probe, and ADR-1939 §4 (Vera coaches with questions only, never drafts as diffs) changes what that gate can mean for copy, which is an owner-session decomposition (ADR-1573).

append.detail: 2026-11-14 (first creation-time slice, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS; no migration). Built to ADR-1939 §4 (questions only, never copy, never drafts as diffs) and ADR-976 D-4 (speaks first only at creation). SHIPPED: lib/builder/vera-coach.ts (pure) mints one Anthropic tool per block from the block contract's own fields (coachTool over inspectorFields, the E5 field list), the reseedBlockCopy idea turned to coaching. Every leaf of its schema is a closed enum: field is one of that block's word fields (text and textarea only; urls, toggles, enums, images and lists are not asked about) and questionId is one of the reviewed catalog's ids (lib/ai/coaching-question-catalog.ts). There is no string field at all, so no draft, rewrite or injected instruction has a channel back; the test walks the schema and asserts it. parseBlockCoaching reads the reply against THIS block and rejects it whole on any unknown field, unreviewed id, extra key or count over 3; the wording shown is the catalog's, labelled with the field's label. veraMayCoachBlock is the creation-time rule: block-created only while every word field is empty, asked always, edit, idle and save never. fallbackBlockCoaching is the no-model answer. lib/ai/vera/block-coach.ts coachNewBlock is the model half: null and no spend when EDITOR_CANVAS is off (envFlag); one forced tool call (haiku, 300 tokens) through withVoice (lib/ai/voice.ts), under the existing seed-compose budget key (the key reseedBlockCopy already spends under; none coined), behind aiEnabled, featureOverBudget and aiRateLimited; AI off, over the cap, rate limited, a thrown call or a reply that does not parse all return the fixed fallback questions. Never throws. Per-Space retrieval is threaded in: the context can carry lib/ai/space-grounding.ts loadSpaceGrounding (public About and offerings) as untrusted data that only steers which question. app/(main)/pages/canvas/actions.ts askVeraAboutCanvasBlock: staff only (getJanitor), off without the switch, the block and its fields fixed on the server (the Banner contract on space-site), client values reduced to capped strings, the trigger re-checked server side. components/builder/inspector/vera-block-coach.tsx sits under the responsive inspector on /pages/canvas: it asks once by itself when the block mounts with its word fields empty, otherwise only on Ask Vera; it renders questions and has no input, so nothing it shows can reach a field. Tests mock every model call (no real call). REMAINS on this row, and why: (1) the coach is mounted only on the staff canvas's demo Banner, not on the selected block of a real document in the Space page builder or the website builder shell (those mount points are BLD/E5 work still open on PROG-E5); (2) reseedBlockCopy itself still asks generic writingCoach questions on the live settings/profile path and was not switched to coachTool, to keep this slice dark; (3) the page-level composer the row names (one prompt to a valid, reviewable, single-undo page), the bounded critic and the ghosted diff review now have to be squared with ADR-1939 §4 (no drafted copy, no copy diffs): the layout-only ghosted proposals in lib/builder/vera.ts (BLD-402) are the part that survives, and that cut is an owner-session decomposition per ADR-1573; (4) the coerce* readers over tool_use inputs outside lib/ai/, and a count_tokens reading of Vera's prefix with the cache counts on /admin/ai, are unchanged; (5) accept and dismiss telemetry for her questions (EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE §8.1 item 8) is not registered.
